Compare Table Columns or Arrays with Arrays of a NumPy Archive

Source: R/analysis-compare.R
CompareArrays.Rd

Compares observed vectors or matrices (taken from columns of a table or elements of a list) with reference arrays, read from an .npz archive with cellspecR::cs_read_npz() or given as a list. Shapes must agree; values are compared exactly or within an absolute tolerance.

Usage

CompareArrays(observed, reference, arrays, tolerance = 0, check = "arrays")

Arguments

observed

A data frame or named list.

reference

Path to an .npz archive, or a named list of arrays.

arrays

Named list: reference array name to the observed column(s) or element. Several columns are bound into a matrix in the given order.

tolerance

Absolute tolerance (numbers).

check

Label stored in column check.

Value

A data frame with one row per array: check, row_key (array name), array, observed_dim, reference_dim, reference_type, n_values, n_different, max_difference, tolerance, matches and status (MATCH, MISMATCH, SHAPE_MISMATCH).

Examples

obs <- data.frame(a = 1:3, b = c(0, 1, 0), z = c(0.5, 1.5, 2.5))
ref <- list(counts = cbind(1:3, c(0, 1, 0)), z = c(0.5, 1.5, 2.5))
CompareArrays(obs, ref, list(counts = c("a", "b"), z = "z"))
#>    check row_key  array observed_dim reference_dim reference_type n_values
#> 1 arrays  counts counts          3x2           3x2         double        6
#> 2 arrays       z      z            3             3         double        3
#>   n_different max_difference tolerance matches status
#> 1           0              0         0    TRUE  MATCH
#> 2           0              0         0    TRUE  MATCH
